findings.problem: Build configuration and diagnostic mode are not explicitly separated; requested Release/Debug/default logging/tracing cost behavior remains ambiguous.
findings.required_fix: Specify no implicit listener/provider/exporter or global subscriber; explicitly gated bounded logging; correctness counters remain; separate Release/Debug and disabled/sampled/full/exporter-fault cost rows. Preserve limited Release AOT observation scope.
findings.resolution: D19 now distinguishes Release/Debug defaults and explicit diagnostic modes; B20/B23 matrix matches. Added diagnostics-final-ci is independent-platform Release evidence only.

findings.problem: rmcp body cap alone does not reserve or bound materialized JSON values and subsequent UTF8/DTO overlap under D07 preallocation rules.
findings.required_fix: Bind D07 to native pre-parse structural/peak-size admission or verified conservative bound; reject impossible expansion before entering materializing SDK parse, with future B19 negative oracle. This is a design policy clarification, not required product implementation now.
findings.resolution: D19 now pins the private expect_json collect/from_slice seam and specifies a public Tower admission wrapper with a budgeted wire buffer, mature serde structural preflight, charged scratch, exact-profile conservative live native/managed peak reservation, bounded replay Body and pre-SDK-parse rejection. B19 requires tiny-element/depth/escape/overlap negative fixtures with zero SDK-parse/Handler admission on failed reservation. An unproved profile cannot be enabled. This closes the design policy; the implementation and numeric bound proof remain future B19 acceptance.

findings.problem: Legacy verification text still describes Rust as optional when not performance-proven despite required Rust architecture.
findings.required_fix: State measured cost informs Rust engine optimization; Kestrel remains comparator only.
findings.resolution: Current R27 graph uses mandatory Rust composition and comparator-only Kestrel language.

task_decisions.title: Kestrel 与纯 C# AOT 比较基线
task_decisions.substantive_review: 已审真实 Kestrel 研究程序、静态 AOT 路由、流/请求边界断言和 Windows/Linux 原始证据。5 项执行只建立可复用等价比较入口；其网络能力没有被误作 NativeWeave 正式 Host。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B23 以相同语义/数据/协议/负载比较完整产品；当前未声称 Rust 有实测吞吐或内存优势。

task_decisions.title: 必需 Rust Host 与 C# Handler 边界
task_decisions.substantive_review: Tokio/Hyper/Tower 与选择性 Axum 的复用和 Adapter 边界具体；C# 静态 Handler 注册复用预编译 native。通知只借用票据，Request/owned-header 领取与拒绝释放明确，不另建大型 Core runtime。旧 optional-Rust 文字已修。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B15/B17 将来执行真实两语言 Handler、panic/异常、拒绝/取消/关闭和普通无 Rust 消费；研究切片不冒充完整 Host。

task_decisions.title: Tonic、rmcp 与 rustls 协议适配
task_decisions.substantive_review: 独立复读 Tonic unary/trailers 源码、作者 19 项与另一执行者 5 项 cardinality 反例/修复；每请求 Decoder 的单消息模式区分零消息/空 payload，并保留流式多消息。rmcp 公共服务接缝、准确 profile、运行时 metadata、认证/Origin、TLS 分层清楚；补齐 JSON 物化前预算。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B18/B19 证明完整 C# ABI+HTTP2/TLS 互操作、压缩/解码峰值与 MCP preflight 实际公式；原有13项两OS、19项Linux和独立5项Linux范围分别保留。

task_decisions.title: 字节预算、背压、取消与关闭
task_decisions.substantive_review: 明确 Tower ResponseFuture permit 与 Body 终结、HTTP2 flow credit 与 backing bytes 存活的差别。双侧独立预算、分配前许可、copy 重叠双记账、last-owner 退休和 active/retiring slots 满足关闭期上界推理。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B16/B17/B22 用真实慢读、半关闭、retain、取消/EOF/close 竞争检验资源退休与有限 deadline；队列项数不等同 RSS 上界。

task_decisions.title: 诊断关联与成本
task_decisions.substantive_review: 源码、布局探针与改正计量窗的两OS Release AOT 原始输出已核。默认 Release/Debug 均不隐式启动 listener/exporter；日志 IsEnabled 与 trace sampling 分离。诊断失败不阻止业务释放，先前 Windows 失败仍保留。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B20 证明真正跨 FFI parent/golden bytes/非法字段；B23 分测 Debug、disabled/sampled/full、日志、Meter、exporter 故障。零线程分配观察不能外推零开销。

task_decisions.title: 参考应用与幂等/Unknown 恢复
task_decisions.substantive_review: 规范给出 operations/items/outbox/attachments、租户/hash/留存、独立事务观察者与外部 oracle。COMMIT Unknown 不被 cleanup 改写，冲突幂等查询使用新 statement snapshot；与数据库独立审查确认的真实 PG 反例一致。
task_decisions.future_obligations_and_limits: B21/B22/B23 实现全栈故障、重启、durable blob-before-reference、outbox 至少一次、30分钟/24小时/72小时分层负载与等价统计。当前设计接受不宣称这些已执行。
